svg.title: Playwright Browser: the model drives a real browser
svg.desc: The model drives a real Chromium browser itself, one tool call per action, using the eighteen tools PlaywrightBrowser adds, such as navigate, snapshot, click and type_text. Chromium starts on the first browser call and closes when the run ends. Every request passes an egress guard that enforces allowed_domains and refuses private addresses. Each tool returns the page text, trimmed to a token budget, or a screenshot as image content.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
